newsitem.title: BELGIUM: German recovery stronger than expected - Issing.
newsitem.headline: German recovery stronger than expected - Issing.

text.p: Bundesbank board member Otmar Issing said on Friday that Germany's economic recovery was stronger than many expected but there was no reason to worry.

"The recovery is stronger than many expected but it is far from showing any sign -- I would not even mention the word overheating," he told the annual meeting of the European Mortgage Federation in Brussels.

Asked whether his comment on German television on Wednesday that there was no reason to expect a lowering of German interest rates applied to the Lombard rate, he said "I did not mention any specific rate, I was just saying that the set of rates for the time being is OK."
"This was not a kind of forecast for the next decade," he said, speaking in English. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
